visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit Bobbi Brown cosmetics store. He holds a black RODE microphone and a gold-colored makeup compact. The background is filled with neatly arranged cosmetic displays, posters of models, and bright overhead lights. (2) A female store manager wearing a professional black outfit joins him. They stand in front of a makeup counter. She gestures towards the makeup products. The camera stays at a medium shot, capturing their upper bodies and expressions. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand applying a powder foundation to a forearm, demonstrating the texture and coverage. The lighting emphasizes the smoothness of the skin. Several bottles of foundation are visible in the background. (4) The scene shifts to the man applying the powder to his own cheek with a white sponge while looking into the product's mirror. He smiles and gives a thumbs-up. (5) A new product, a pink blush, is introduced. The woman holds the compact while the man points at it. Close-ups show the product being swatched on the man's hand. (6) They then demonstrate a shimmering highlighter powder. A close-up shows the textured surface of the highlighter. The woman applies it to her cheekbone while looking in a handheld mirror. (7) A white lipstick tube is shown and swatched on the hand. The woman applies the lipstick to her lips. The lighting highlights the glossy finish. (8) The man stands alone again in the store, waving at the camera and smiling, concluding the demonstration.
